g.text: (a) The video is egocentric/first-person perspective, captured from a camera mounted on a drone. The drone flew to

text.style: font: 12px 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: the left at a constant altitude, and the camera captured several horses grazing or moving freely near the stream

text.style: font: 12px 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: and the orange pond, without focusing on specific targets.
